newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SKF says plans for growth in seals unit.
newsitem.headline: SKF says plans for growth in seals unit.

text.p: Swedish ballbearing company SKF AB is planning for growth within its sealing unit, company president Peter Augustsson said on Friday.

"We clearly have a goal to grow in sealing. This is an interesting business where there are synergies with our roller bearings, particularly when it comes to the customer base," Augustsson told Reuters in an interview.

The core of the division, which has an annual turnover of around four or 4.5 billion crowns, is SKF's U.S. subsidiary, Chicago Rawhide. The division also has two plants in Europe -- one in Italy and one in Germany.
"These plants are a good base for good development on the European market. And we will grow in Europe," Augustsson said.
In Japan SKF has a joint venture with Koyo, which is number two on the Japanese market.
"Today we are strong in North America, we have a presence in Europe and we are small in Asia. Now we will grow," he said.
